title: Nutty New Japanese Pappardelle Zenzai-Style
description: A citrusy and snappy Japanese dish featuring pappardelle pasta and ferment-jang, perfect for a quick and energizing vegetarian meal.
instructions: Cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until it is al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the ferment-jang, soy sauce, sugar, and sesame seeds to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Add the citrus segments and green onions to the skillet and toss to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the ingredients are heated through.
Stir in the toasted sesame seeds and water.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional green onions and citrus segments if desired.
